lesson-intro.text: Falling water has no shape of its own, so we show it with straight lines and a puff of mist where it lands. Watch it come down, then turn your own water on.

left-side.text: The cliff is a tall block. Draw the top edge, then down the left side.

right-side.text: Now the right side, lumpy like the left. A gap runs down the middle.

fall.text: Two straight lines drop through the gap, from top to bottom.

water-lines.text: Three more straight lines inside, side by side, the middle one lower.

mist.text: Where the water lands there is mist. Draw a cloud with three bumps on top.

pool.text: The pool spreads out below in one wide, wavy curve.

rocks.text: Three rocks sit in the water, each a low dome, all different sizes.

ripples.text: A small curve each side of every rock, like water moving around it.

bushes.text: Bushes grow on the cliff, four soft clumps at the corners.

water-blue.text: Color the falling water and the pool blue.

cliff-brown.text: The cliff and the three rocks are brown.

bushes-mist.text: The bushes are green, and the mist is gray.

lesson-outro.text: You can almost feel the spray, and it is only straight lines and one cloud.
